Recently, gaming media outlet GameRant reported a notable trick allowing players to acquire Andrew Node's Thrax—described as the fastest supercar in GTA 6—by utilizing a specific glitch method.

For players looking to dominate the streets of the new open world, securing top-tier vehicles is always a primary objective. According to the report, the Thrax stands out as an exceptionally fast supercar in GTA 6, making it a highly desirable asset for speed enthusiasts.

The method highlighted by GameRant involves using a noclip effect to pass directly through a garage door. While utilizing glitches is often viewed as a shortcut by the community, it bypasses standard acquisition barriers, offering an alternative route to access high-end content that might otherwise require extensive progression.

Players attempting these shortcuts should always consider the potential for hotfixes and stability adjustments.

Glitch-hunting has always been a fascinating subculture within the GTA community. While pulling off a noclip trick to grab the Thrax supercar sounds like an exciting adventure, players should approach such unverified methods with caution, keeping in mind that developer patches could alter these mechanics at any time.
